classes.C1: The format attribute is now honoured for tags that came from dynamic_tag posts (the post path ignored it).
classes.C2: processing="false" is now honoured for tags that came from dynamic_tag posts (the post path ignored it).
classes.C3: Tokens only a table row can answer ({tag_name}, {tag_id}, {usage_count}, {user_id}) now expand for tags that came from posts.
classes.C4: Nested shortcodes now expand in tags that came from posts (the post path never ran do_shortcode on the content).
classes.C5: {meta:} with an empty key renders nothing instead of the word Array (B7, already approved on the post path).
classes.C6: The placeholder engine now runs for table-native tags: {meta:}, {acf:}, {wc:}, formatters, ?? fallbacks, role and field conditions resolve instead of staying raw.
classes.C7: Shared tokens come from the engine for table-native tags: {user_name} is empty for guests and the login name for users, {user_role} expands, {current_date} uses the site's date format, post tokens are empty without a post.
classes.C8: format= applied to text the engine now resolves (a date is no longer the ISO form the harness normalizes).
classes.C9: The core shortcodes ([dt], [dt_group], [dt_template]) read the table, so a tag that exists only as a row is found; the baseline rendered nothing for it.
